ai_summary: AceVector Limited (formerly Snapdeal Limited) has successfully resolved a significant tax dispute, as the Hon'ble Delhi High Court dismissed the Income Tax Department's appeal regarding a ₹322.40 crore disallowance of advertising expenses for Assessment Year 2017-18. This ruling is a material positive impact, enabling the company to avoid a potential tax liability of approximately ₹111.57 crore and reinforcing its declared financial position. No red flags are identified, as the outcome is entirely favorable to the company.
